ext.description: A tile dashboard for your projects: descriptions, logos, collections, git branch, last commit and languages.
view.welcome:
The dashboard opens in its own editor tab.
[Open Dashboard](command:projectTiles.open)
[Add Current Folder](command:projectTiles.addCurrentFolder)
cfg.openInNewWindow: Open projects in a new window by default (Ctrl+click does the opposite).
cfg.showOnStartup: Open the dashboard automatically when a window starts without a folder.
cfg.columns: Preferred number of tile columns. Fewer are used automatically when the window is too narrow.
cfg.fetchRemote: Run `git fetch` before computing ahead/behind so tiles show commits not yet pulled. Uses the network; when off, the badge is grey and compares against the last local fetch.
cfg.metadataCacheMinutes: Minimum interval (minutes) between remote checks when the dashboard is reopened. 0 = check every time it opens.
cfg.languageCacheHours: How long (hours) a language scan is reused before the project is scanned again. 0 = rescan on every refresh.
cfg.maxFilesScanned: Maximum number of files scanned per project for language detection.
cfg.languageIgnoreDirs: Directory names skipped during language detection.
